name: Citicoline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Citicoline is broken down in the gut wall and liver to choline and cytidine; under 3% of a dose appears in urine and feces, and about 12% leaves as exhaled carbon dioxide. The Spanish label gives no kidney dose adjustment and no dialysis data. It has no US FDA label (sold in the US only as a supplement).
kidney_function_basis: The SmPC does not address kidney impairment; bands are shown on creatinine clearance (CrCl) for consistency.

bands.recommendation: Usual dose: 500 to 2,000 mg/day orally depending on severity (SmPC).
The SmPC gives no kidney dosing (under 3% of a dose is excreted in urine and feces). Use with caution and specialist judgment.
